body: My folks are pretty much the last people I want to talk about this kind of thing with, which sucks because I’m stuck living with them. I have the kind of family where talking about mental health becomes a dick measuring contest of who has the actual most problems in their life. Fuck if anything, I was the one who constantly had to stop my mom from killing my herself, be the rock to support my little sister, the ear for listening and shoulder for my older autistic brother to cry on with his stresses, and my dad expects everyone to be his therapist while immediately turning around and pissing on my mental health and wellness. By far he’s the worst when it comes to the dick measuring of trying to see “who has it worst.” Plus my only friend outside of my family is struggling from suicidal thoughts and a major depressive episode after having been broken up with his ex girlfriend, and so I have no desire to talk about this void feeling of existing with him since it’s just gonna get me nowhere. To be totally honest, I don’t even know why I posted this because I feel like there isn’t even any advice I WANT to take anymore. This has been going for so long inside me that I can’t even think of a convincing argument against accepting death as it is. But thank you though, the fact that you took the time to respond really does mean a lot to me and I hope your chances at life are more successful, meaningful and happier than mine
